# Hotel alpi.in

> Hotel in Arta Terme, Carnia (Friuli Venezia Giulia, Italy), at the foot of
> Mount Zoncolan. Rooms, dorms, ski/bike storage and local breakfast — a base
> for skiing, cycling and hiking in the Carnic Alps.

Hotel alpi.in offers 6 room types (single, double, triple, quad, and 7- or
8-bed dorms), from EUR 30 to EUR 120 per night, breakfast included. Located
at Via Fontana 21, 33022 Arta Terme (UD), Italy. The site is available in
Italian (default), English and German.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.hotelalpi-in.it/it): Overview of the hotel, location and guest reviews.
- [Rooms](https://www.hotelalpi-in.it/it/camere): All room types, prices and booking form.
- [The Area](https://www.hotelalpi-in.it/it/territorio): Skiing, cycling, hiking and the Arta Terme thermal baths.
- [Extra Services & Retreat](https://www.hotelalpi-in.it/it/servizi-extra-retreat): Additional services and corporate/group retreats.
